product_one_liner.value: SMS-Magic is a CRM-integrated conversational messaging platform that helps business marketing, sales and support teams engage prospects and customers through SMS, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger and other channels.

employee_band.notes: The funding profile reports 205 employees for the operating Indian entity as of 2025-08-01; the jobs directory also lists the 201–500 band.

hq_location.notes: The company labels Henderson its Global/U.S. Headquarters; the same careers page also describes Pune as its founding headquarters and development center.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains messaging, customer-engagement, compliance and product how-to content, not a qualifying engineer-authored engineering blog.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current 20-role directory lists no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. Older AI hiring announcements were found, but do not establish a currently open role; the official careers page does not expose individual vacancies.

model_provider.notes: Product documentation explicitly supports customer-connected OpenAI models using an API key and optional Assistant ID. The company’s Voice AI explainer also names GPT-4o among the technologies integrated into its platform; no exclusive/default provider is established.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the company’s published compliance claims, not independent verification of current certification scope; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance regimes rather than formal certifications.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile explicitly says the company is unfunded and has not raised any funding rounds; no round date or amount is reported.

raised_18mo.notes: No funding rounds are reported. Window: 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive – APAC Region listing is available; the jobs directory also lists Account Executive and SDR openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The 2026-09-28 release introduces IVR caller-data capture and conditional routing, recurring voice campaigns and other substantial capabilities, within the 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete current executive roster with start dates was available. The verified Vikas Narang COO appointment was announced on 2025-10-01, before the 2025-11-09 cutoff; no in-window C-level or VP-level join or departure was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Signals include documented product integrations and CRM familiarity requested in the Account Executive posting; they do not prove internal deployment of every listed system.
